authorization: Successor user attachment authorizes evidence-based delivery, commits, ordinary pushes and relevant non-secret configurations, historical metrics, versions, failures and scientific evidence; direct message also authorizes this destination and branch.
scope: Only campaign export and targeted offline-check logs. Historical artifacts are robot configurations, trajectories, MuJoCo models, evaluations, receipts, numerical guesses, fact manifests, model request schemas and budgets.
nested_sensitive_keys: Only authorization attribution and false/zero review flags; no credential values.
home_path_scope: Test tracebacks refer only to the authorized existing softagent Python environment site-packages; no home file content, .env or credentials exported.
